name: 1 Person Far Infrared Sauna (GSE-1)
description:
Single Person Infrared Sauna
This personal infrared sauna gives you gives you the relaxing oasis you’ve always dreamed of. Made out of the highest quality Forest Stewardship Certified Wood, this single person sauna delivers some of the best infrared heat saunas have to offer. In addition to strengthening your immune system and helping with detoxification, you will experience premium therapeutic chromotherapy lightening and a high quality music sound system to take you to a whole new relaxing level.
